title: Reflections on Hybrid Memory with Commander Sol: Minimal Joint Rigidity of Partial Operations
description: We study hybrid memory in finite systems of partial operations: information absent from either operational reduct separately but present in their joint structure. We prove a typed Lift-Compatibility Theorem, sharp minimality thresholds for domain-domain, domain-value, value-value and shared-output synchronization regimes, an absolute two-cell one-sorted witness, two exhaustive small classifications, and a scalable carrier-value selector ladder. The paper carefully separates output semantics and does not identify finite rigidity with arithmetic recovery.
references: P. Burmeister (1986), A Model Theoretic Oriented Approach to Partial Algebras, DOI 10.1515/9783112720875.
